name: Akanesasu Sekai de Kimi to Utau
original_name: 茜さすセカイでキミと詠う
source:
One day, guided by a peculiar voice, our heroine is suddenly thrust into a different dimension. She has landed in a parallel world called ‘Hinomoto’ where many historical figures live.

'Hinomoto' was once a land which was blessed by the sun. However, when the sun stopped rising the land became a region of Polar Nights. At such a time, beings called ‘Shikigami’ started appearing suddenly, spiriting people away. The people struggling against the Shikigami prayed for the arrival of their Priestess.

Our heroine was guided by a messenger of the Moon Goddess, Tsukuyomi, as the priestess tasked to find the ‘Norito’, an invocation to awaken the sun.

[From [url=https://akaseka.fandom.com/wiki/Reciting_With_You_in_the_Glowing_Red_World_Wikia]Fandom[/url]]
translation:
某一天，在一道奇异声音的引导下，女主人公突然被带往另一个次元。她来到一个名叫“日之许”的平行世界，许多历史人物都生活在这里。

“日之许”曾经是一片受到太阳恩惠的土地。然而，太阳不再升起后，这里便陷入了极夜。此时，被称为“式神”的存在突然出现，让人们接连遭遇神隐、消失无踪。艰难对抗式神的人们，祈求着巫女降临。

在月神月读的使者指引下，女主人公成为巫女，肩负起寻找唤醒太阳的“祝词”的使命。

[摘自[url=https://akaseka.fandom.com/wiki/Reciting_With_You_in_the_Glowing_Red_World_Wikia]Fandom[/url]]
